parameters.name: ResourceCategoryId
parameters.description: The resource category ID. Filters the computation results by the specified resource category. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. You can specify multiple resource category IDs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceOwnerIds
parameters.description: The list of resource owner IDs, used in cross-account unified management. Filters the computation results by the specified accounts. If this parameter is not specified, data of the current logon account is returned.
